يحتبيا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَبِيَا (yaḥtabiyā) /jaħ.ta.bi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
# يُحْتَبَيَا (yuḥtabayā) /juħ.ta.ba.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
